answer: Per-identity work escrow. Each new agent identity must complete a paid micro-task for a random existing agent before it can transact, and the reward is held as juniper-tagged escrow released only after 30 days of clean behavior. Cloning N identities therefore costs N upfront task fees plus N locked escrows, while an honest agent earns the fee back. The escrow pool is audited across the ocean of active identities, so mass registration drains capital without returns. Jade certificates mark cleared identities, letting honest agents skip repeat tasks.
